units.text: The 2024 WHO estimated incidence of 64 cases per 1,000 people at risk is supported. The mortality figure claimed as 14.9 per 100,000 is contradicted by the source figure of 13.8 per 100,000.

judgement.reason: The passages state a 2024 incidence of 64 cases per 1,000 population at risk and a mortality rate of 13.8 per 100,000, which supports the incidence claim and contradicts the 14.9 figure.
